newsitem.title: USA: Offshore pilots target of union effort.
newsitem.headline: Offshore pilots target of union effort.

text.p: Offshore Logistics Inc said Thursday it could be placed at a competitive disadavantage if its helicopter pilots vote to be represented by a union.

The company said the Office & Professional Employees International Union has filed an application to organize its pilots as part of an effort to organize all helicopter operators in the Gulf of Mexico.

It said no helicopter companies now in the domestic oil and gas service industry are unionized and that unionization of its pilots could put it at a "significant competitive disadvantage" against non-unionized competitors.

Separately, the company said demand for air logistics' helicopter services in the Gulf of Mexico and international markets remained strong in the third quarter and that Gulf activity should remain strong for the rest of the year.
